jump: Lực nhảy x (1.0-3.0) now multiplies the magnitude returned by Player.get_RisingGravity. Rationale: launch speed v0 = sqrt(2*H*|g_rise|) while the ascent uses get_CustomGravity (HADKJKALGOL 0x568CE60 only takes the Rising/Falling branch when InSnowSlideWayDashing), so apex = H*|g_rise|/|g_custom| and scales linearly with the slider. The R11.70 GameVarDef.JSDeadGhostJumpScale write was reverted: that field belongs to the ghost/replay jump path (ELGCCFOEIID is only reached from ICBEPIHDJIA, a PraiseKey action).
